name: Putrid Claw
summary: Near Brill, Putrid Claw bounties help hold back the Scourge. Mindless undead roam the woods west of town, especially near the old bridge, and Deathguard Dillinger receives the claws as proof.

sections.title: Trophy of the Mindless
sections.body: The mindless Scourge keeps crossing into Tirisfal Glades. Rotting dead and ravaged corpses wander the eastern borders, gathering along roads and near the old bridge west of Brill. Deathguards offer bounties on these horrors to protect travelers and garrison supply lines. A severed putrid claw proves one more shambling corpse has been put down for good.

faq.q: What are putrid claws used for?
faq.answer: Deathguard Dillinger in Brill collects putrid claws as bounties. They show that local Forsaken recruits are thinning the Scourge wandering Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Where do putrid claws come from?
faq.answer: Putrid claws come from the rotting dead and ravaged corpses that roam the haunted woods west of Brill, especially near the old river bridge.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: After Lordaeron's devastation, remnants of the Lich King's mindless Scourge keep crossing west into Tirisfal. They menace roads and settlements unless someone culls them.

faq.q: Why don't the Forsaken just let the mindless undead wander?
faq.answer: Queen Sylvanas and the Forsaken broke free of the Lich King's reach and regained their will. The mindless Scourge obey dark instincts or his lingering command, attacking any living or free undead on sight.

angles.text: As a fresh Forsaken initiate leaving Deathknell, you see that liberation means defending against the mindless husks you once resembled.
